sloka: ते भिन्नाश्च विकीर्णाश्च रामरावणयोः शराः ।अन्तरिक्षात् प्रदीप्ताग्रा निपेतुर्धरणीतले ।। ६.१०१.६१ ।।
transliteration: te bhinnāśca vikīrṇāśca rāmarāvaṇayoḥ śarāḥ ।antarikṣāt pradīptāgrā nipeturdharaṇītale ।। 6.101.61 ।।

translations.english: Showered upon and afflicted by the volleys of arrows of that great-souled wielder of the flaming bow, Ravana turned and fled in fear, as a cloud driven before the gale.
